summary: Two pictures under one divider, dragged across or moved with the arrow keys, to show a before and an after.

props.name: before
props.description: The picture on the left, before the change.

props.name: after
props.description: The picture on the right, after it.

props.name: alt
props.description: What both pictures show, for screen readers.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: The label over the left side. `""` drops it.

props.name: afterLabel
props.description: The label over the right side. `""` drops it.

props.name: defaultPosition
props.description: Where the divider starts, in percent from the left.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: The frame's width over its height, such as `16 / 10`.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the frame. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
